newsitem.title: USA: Egypt mill buys 55,000 T U.S. HRW wheat -exporters.
newsitem.headline: Egypt mill buys 55,000 T U.S. HRW wheat -exporters.

text.p: An Egyptian flour miller over the weekend bought 55,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat for September 20-30 shipment, several U.S. exporters said. It was a private sale, they said.
The wheat was bought at $150.25 a tonne, C & F, U.S. Gulf of Mexico, one U.S. exporter said.
The Egyptian buyer tendered for three cargoes of 55,000 tonnes each of U.S. HRW wheat or Australian hard wheat on Friday night for September, October and November shipment, one U.S. exporter said.
"They passed on the October and November and bought the September 20-30 shipment," he said.
